ILLUSTRATIVE APP PREVIEW

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
join the circle.

What can I book on Artist House?+

Explore makeup, photography, hair styling, editing and content creation. Open a professional’s profile in the app to see their services, work samples and session prices.

How does service pricing work?+

Professionals set prices for each service per session. Review your selected service and the total booking amount in the app before paying.

What do the profile badges mean?+

The black or white Artist House badge indicates admin approval. A gold badge indicates a connected Instagram account; that connection alone is not proof of skills or ownership of every work sample.

Can I join as a professional?+

Yes. Use the professional app to add your services, fees and portfolio. Upload your own work samples without watermarks, company names or logos.

Is Artist House available on iPhone?+

A native iPhone app is not available yet. Contact support for the current access options.
